_about: SHELF of Spanish, Spanish-American and Brazilian classics in English before 1931: Underhill's four series of Benavente's Plays (1917-1924), the Martínez Sierra plays in Underhill's and the Granville-Barkers' versions (1922), Rollo Ogden's Isaacs María (1890), Mrs. Horace Mann's Sarmiento Facundo (1868), Isabel Burton's Alencar Iraçéma (1886) and Walsh and de la Selva's Darío (1916). Mary J. Serrano's Valera and Mármol are on the serrano shelf. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 93); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. Common surnames (walsh, mann, ogden, burton) are never listed bare.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.

_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
